description: DRAFTS a payment request and returns a shareable link. This never signs anything, never sends anything, and never marks anything paid — the whole request rides inside the link, and only the payer’s wallet, with their approval, can actually move money. The link opens in the NimBooks app; the payment it produces carries the reference nimbooks:invoice:<id>, which check_request_paid looks for later. Note: inside the link, the payload field amountNim is denominated in Luna by the app’s link format; this tool’s own output reports amountNim in NIM and amountLuna in Luna.

amountNim.description: Amount in NIM, as a decimal string — "12.5". Up to 5 decimals (1 NIM = 100000 Luna).

expiry.description: When the request stops being valid: "1h", "24h", "7d", "none" (default), or an ISO 8601 timestamp.

id.description: Fixed request id, for reproducible links. Generated when omitted.

memo.description: What the request is for, up to 80 characters. Travels in the link, not on chain.

payee.description: Address to be paid. Optional; defaults to the server’s configured address.

name: create_payment_request
title: Draft a payment request
